admin.description: ADMIN (user_id 99), may read every order and the admin order listing

customer_bob.description: CUSTOMER bob (user_id 2, owns cart 102), a second customer for ownership checks

business_rules.description: The product catalog is public (no token needed) and lists every product with its current stock.
An unknown product id returns 404 with an error object (detail.code, detail.message).
Each customer has one cart: the response is the caller's own cart (alice owns cart 101, bob cart 102) and total_amount is the sum of the items' line_total.
The added quantity is between 1 and 100 (otherwise 422) and an unknown product_id returns 404.
Removing an item of the caller's cart returns 204 and the item no longer appears in GET /cart.
Only the caller's own cart can be checked out (another customer's cart_id -> 403); the new order starts in status PENDING.
Duplicate product lines are combined before stock is validated; a new order starts in status PENDING and does not reserve stock.
An unknown order id returns 404; ADMIN may read any customer's order.
Paying an owned PENDING order moves it to PAID; stock is validated again and deducted when the payment succeeds.
A cancelled order has status CANCELLED; cancelling a PAID order restores its deducted stock.
The order listing is restricted to the ADMIN role (other roles -> 403) and returns the orders of every customer.
Coupon SAVE10 gives a 10% discount on an owned cart whose subtotal is at least 100; an unknown code returns 404.
